headline: Sanofi agrees to buy Insmed for about 41 billion dollars, adding Brinsupri and Arikayce
new_fact: On November 24, 2026 Sanofi and Insmed announced a definitive agreement at 175 dollars per share in cash, about 41 billion dollars, expected to close in the first half of 2027.
